# Konstantin Zavarov — https://zavarov.com/

> Личный блог Константина Заварова. Автор — Константин Заваров, Head of Product в Ozon. Контент на русском языке.

## Об авторе

Константин Заваров — Head of Product в Ozon с 12+ годами опыта в IT. Ранее работал в Яндексе, Мегамаркете и Лаборатории Касперского. С 2021 по 2025 год вел курсы в Яндекс Практикуме. Ведет Telegram-канал «Код Продакта» (https://t.me/pmgen).

## Статьи
- [The Brand Age, Paul Graham](https://zavarov.com/en/brandage/): Reflections on Paul Graham's essay 'The Brand Age': why technological advantage is temporary and when betting on brand becomes a matter of survival.
- [Product Strategy ≠ Template](https://zavarov.com/en/product-strategy/): There's no universal product strategy template — and there never will be. On what strategy can look like in practice, and why it's a living system, not a document.
- [Second Brain: PARA × Obsidian × Granola × Claude](https://zavarov.com/en/second-brain/): How to build a knowledge management system from PARA, Obsidian, Granola, and Claude — and why it works like a second brain.
- [People Who Write Interestingly](https://zavarov.com/en/people/): A curated list of authors who write compelling content on product-related topics and are worth coming back to.
- [Prioritization Methods: ICE, RICE, DRICE](https://zavarov.com/en/drice/): A detailed breakdown of the ICE, RICE, and DRICE task prioritization methods: formulas, examples, and a comparison of approaches.
- [10 Deadly Sins of a Beginning Product Manager](https://zavarov.com/en/10-evils/): 10 key mistakes beginner product managers make that hinder professional growth and consistent business performance.
- [Thinking Through Writing](https://zavarov.com/en/text/): How Amazon's document-centric culture develops critical thinking, and why the ability to work with text matters for product managers.
- [Books and Materials for Product Managers](https://zavarov.com/en/pm-materials/): A curated list of the best books, courses, and materials for developing product skills. Regularly updated.
- [The Evolution of Goal-Setting Frameworks: From OKR to NCT](https://zavarov.com/en/nct/): The evolution of goal-setting frameworks: from MBO and OKR to NCT — a framework by Ravi Mehta that could replace OKR.
- [Product CEO: How a Product Manager Creates Meaning and Communicates Value](https://zavarov.com/en/pm-ceo/): How a product manager creates meaning and communicates the value of a product to the business, the team, and the users.
- [Tools and Services for Product Managers](https://zavarov.com/en/pm-tools/): Sharing the tools I use in my work for building products, managing business processes, and handling personal tasks
- [The Growth Dilemma of Educational Course Economics](https://zavarov.com/en/edtech/): Why the economics of educational courses don't scale well, and what the growth dilemma looks like for edTech companies in the Russian-speaking internet market.
- [Product Management Is Marketing Management](https://zavarov.com/en/kotler/): Why a product manager is essentially a marketing specialist, and how this understanding changes the approach to product management.
- [Loyalty ≠ Satisfaction](https://zavarov.com/en/nps-csi/): Why loyalty and satisfaction are different concepts, and how to measure them correctly using NPS and CSI.
- [On Leadership](https://zavarov.com/en/leader/): What leadership is, why it matters, and where to start if you want to develop the skill of positively influencing people.
- [Calculating Classic, Rolling, and Full Retention in Python](https://zavarov.com/en/retention/): A walkthrough of how to manually calculate 3 types of Retention metrics using Python and Pandas, and how to plot a Retention curve using Matplotlib.
- [Chart Templates for Data Visualization](https://zavarov.com/en/template-diagrams/): A Google Sheets template with reference chart examples for visualizing product, business, and financial data.
- [The Zettelkasten Note-Taking Method](https://zavarov.com/en/zettelkasten/): The increasingly popular note-taking method from the extraordinarily prolific German sociologist Niklas Luhmann.
- [How to Run a Retrospective for a Large Team](https://zavarov.com/en/retrospective/): A detailed 8-step plan with timings for running an engaging retrospective for a large team (10+ people).
- [A/B Test Design Template](https://zavarov.com/en/template-abt/): A Google Sheets template for designing A/B tests: hypothesis formulation, sample size calculation, and experiment duration.
- [ICE, RICE, DRICE Prioritization Framework Template](https://zavarov.com/en/template-rice/): A Google Sheets template for prioritizing product initiatives using the ICE, RICE, and DRICE methods.
- [On the Certified Scrum Product Owner Certification](https://zavarov.com/en/cspo/): What to expect from CSPO training and certification beyond just another badge to collect.
